current_milestone: OSCAR INT2 + delta-mem combo fully characterised on RTX 3060 12 GB. Quality ceiling at ~17-20 k context bounded by published adapter's training distribution. Pivoting to Strix Halo (96 GB ROCm) for long-context adapter fine-tuning; see STRIX_INSTRUCTIONS.md.

what_we_proved_this_session.experiment: v5 — clean reproduction (OSCAR INT2 + GPQA-rot + packing + cross-arm invalidation, conv-26/10q, 17 590 tokens)
what_we_proved_this_session.verdict: Production combo confirmed stable; ratio above paper's 1.20 by 11%.

what_we_proved_this_session.experiment: v4a fresh — INT4 + GPQA-rot at 17 k (was: stale-JSON false-positive on prior attempt)
what_we_proved_this_session.verdict: INT4 is not a win on this stack. Base lifts (delta-mem's noisier-training-target gone), delta arm degrades. INT4 also requires 2x VRAM and OOM'd in delta arm.
Identity rotation is degenerate at INT4 (same failure class as INT2). Rotation is essential at any bit width.

what_we_proved_this_session.experiment: port_debug test F — INT4 + GPQA-rot at 4 k context
what_we_proved_this_session.verdict: OSCAR INT4 path is bit-correct; v4a's 17 k regression is a quality-vs-bit-width / delta-mem-interaction issue, not a port bug.

what_we_proved_this_session.result: Headline OSCAR 7.1x memory vs bf16 (was 2.0x). End-to-end ~2.1 GB freed.
what_we_proved_this_session.verdict: Took the 12 GB card from OOM-risky to comfortable headroom at 17 k.

what_we_proved_this_session.experiment: v6c — context scaling on conv-41 (25 672 tokens, batch=1, shadow OFF)
what_we_proved_this_session.verdict: delta-mem's strength DOES NOT persist past ~17 k. At 25 k ratio inverts from 1.33 win to 0.60 loss. The binding constraint is the adapter's training distribution, not VRAM.

what_we_proved_this_session.result: Lets conv-41 (25 k) complete on 12 GB; v6 (default batch=2 + shadow ON) crashed in delta arm rebuild; v6b (shadow OFF + batch=2) crashed at delta q4; only v6c (both knobs) completed cleanly.
what_we_proved_this_session.verdict: Combined knobs push the VRAM ceiling to ~25 k. Higher would need CPU RAM offload of the shadow (out of scope here; quality already regressed).

hard_earned_lessons_do_not_forget: locomo_eval.py reuses existing output JSONs if present; always rename to *.STALE.json before relaunching.
Cross-arm cache invalidation is required between base and delta arms for non-bf16 KV backends (wired in commit 35612a4).
OSCAR_K_ROTATION_PATH and OSCAR_V_ROTATION_PATH env vars are mandatory whenever KV_CACHE_BACKEND=oscar.
Transient CUDA 'unknown error' crashes on this driver are nuisance noise after long runs; re-run usually fixes them. Not a code bug.
INT4 OSCAR is NOT a quality upgrade over INT2 in this stack. INT4 base improves but delta-mem corrections were calibrated against INT2's noise floor.
